question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Intimate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Distant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Intimate" means closely acquainted; having a close personal relationship. (घनिष्ठ)

 

• "Distant" means not close in relationship or feeling; reserved. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दूर)

◦ Example: After the argument, her tone became noticeably distant, and she avoided any personal conversation for weeks.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Familiar (परिचित) — well known from close association; a synonym of intimate.

• Option 3: Personal (व्यक्तिगत) — private and individual in nature; a synonym of intimate.

• Option 4: Close (घनिष्ठ) — having a strong personal bond; a synonym of intimate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of intimate: Unfamiliar, Reserved, Aloof.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Abandon (त्यागना): Continue (जारी रखना), Retain (संभालकर रखना)

2. Abate (कम करना): Increase (बढ़ाना), Intensify (तेज करना)

3. Abjure (त्यागना): Acquire (प्राप्त करना), Accept (स्वीकार करना)

4. Abolish (समाप्त करना): Establish (स्थापित करना), Continue (जारी रखना)

5. Abominable (घृणित): Admirable (प्रशंसनीय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Triumph".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Defeat.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Triumph" means a great victory or achievement; success after struggle. (विजय)

◦ Example: Winning the championship after such a difficult season felt like a personal triumph for the entire team.

 

• "Defeat" means failure to win or succeed; the state of being beaten, and is therefore the correct antonym. (पराजय)

◦ Example: The army suffered a crushing defeat after being surrounded on three sides by enemy forces.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Success (सफलता): the achievement of an aim or purpose — a synonym of triumph, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Conquest (विजय): the act of overcoming or defeating something — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Victory (जीत): an act of defeating an opponent in a contest — close in sense to triumph.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of triumph: Victory, Success, Conquest, Achievement, Win.

• Synonyms of defeat: Loss, Failure, Setback, Rout, Downfall.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Above (ऊपर): Below (नीचे), Under (नीचे)

2. Abrogate (समाप्त करना): Uphold (बनाए रखना), Maintain (कायम रखना)

3. Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना): Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना)

4. Abstract (भावात्मक): Concrete (ठोस/वास्तविक)

5. Abstruse (कठिन / गूढ़): Clear (स्पष्ट), Simple (सरल)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Sluggish".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Active.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Sluggish" means slow-moving or lacking energy and alertness. (सुस्त)

◦ Example: The economy remained sluggish for years after the global financial crisis struck.

 

• "Active" means engaging or ready to engage in energetic activity, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सक्रिय)

◦ Example: She leads an active lifestyle, exercising every morning before heading to work.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Lazy (आलसी): unwilling to work or use effort — a synonym of sluggish, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Torpid (निष्क्रिय): mentally or physically inactive — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Lethargic (सुस्त): lacking energy; sluggishly tired — close in sense to sluggish.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of sluggish: Lethargic, Lazy, Torpid, Listless, Languid.

• Synonyms of active: Energetic, Lively, Vigorous, Dynamic, Brisk.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Absurd (बेतुका): Reasonable (तार्किक), Sensible (समझदारीपूर्ण)

2. Abundant (प्रचुर): Minimal (न्यूनतम)

3. Accentuate (ज़ोर देना / उभारना): Obscure (छिपाना / अस्पष्ट करना), Downplay (महत्त्व कम करना)

4. Accept (स्वीकार करना): Deny (अस्वीकार करना), Reject (अस्वीकृत)

5. Access (पहुँच): Denial (नकार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Sublime."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Mediocre.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Sublime" means of such excellence as to inspire great admiration or awe. (उत्कृष्ट)

 

• "Mediocre" means of only moderate quality; not very good. It is therefore the correct antonym. (साधारण)

◦ Example: Critics called the film mediocre, noting its weak script and uninspired acting.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Superb (शानदार) — excellent; of very high quality; a synonym of sublime.

• Option 3: Magnificent (भव्य) — impressively beautiful or grand; a synonym of sublime.

• Option 4: Exquisite (अति सुंदर) — extremely beautiful and delicate; a synonym of sublime.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of sublime: Inferior, Ordinary, Average.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Accompany (साथ जाना): Abandon (छोड़ देना), Desert (त्याग देना)

2. Accomplish (पूरा करना): Miss (चूकना), Fail (असफल होना)

3. Accustomed (आदत वाला): Unusual (असामान्य), Unfamiliar (अपरिचित)

4. Acquisition (प्राप्ति): Loss (हानि)

5. Acquitted (दोषमुक्त): Convicted (दोषी ठहराया गया), Guilty (अपराधी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Piquant."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Bland.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Piquant" means having a pleasantly sharp or spicy taste or quality. (चटपटा)

 

• "Bland" means lacking strong flavor; mild and unexciting. It is therefore the correct antonym. (फीका)

◦ Example: The hospital food was so bland that patients often requested extra salt and spices.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Spicy (मसालेदार) — having a strong, hot flavor from spices; a synonym of piquant.

• Option 3: Zesty (तीखा) — having a pleasantly strong flavor; a synonym of piquant.

• Option 4: Tangy (खट्टा-तीखा) — having a sharp, distinctive taste; a synonym of piquant.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of piquant: Tasteless, Insipid, Mild.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Active (सक्रिय): Inert (निष्क्रिय)

2. Adage (कहावत): Misconstruction (गलत अर्थ), Nonsense (बेतुकी बात)

3. Admire (प्रशंसा करना): Despise (घृणा करना), Hate (नफरत करना)

4. Advance (आगे बढ़ना): Retreat (पीछे हटना), Withdraw (वापस लेना)

5. Advanced (उन्नत): Rudimentary (प्रारंभिक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ineluctable."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Avoidable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ineluctable" means unable to be resisted or avoided; inescapable. (अनिवार्य)

 

• "Avoidable" means able to be prevented or evaded; capable of being avoided. It is therefore the correct antonym. (टालने योग्य)

◦ Example: Most workplace accidents are avoidable if companies simply follow basic safety guidelines and proper training.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Inevitable (अवश्यंभावी) — certain to happen; unavoidable; a synonym of ineluctable.

• Option 3: Inescapable (अपरिहार्य) — unable to be avoided or escaped; a synonym of ineluctable.

• Option 4: Unavoidable (अनिवार्य) — not able to be avoided or prevented; a synonym of ineluctable.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of ineluctable: Preventable, Escapable, Avertable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Adventurous (साहसी): Cautious (सावधान), Careful (सतर्क)

2. Affirm (पुष्टि करना): Refuse (इंकार करना), Deny (नकारना)

3. Affirmative (सकारात्मक): Negative (नकारात्मक), Denial (अस्वीकृति)

4. Affluent (धनी): Destitute (गरीब), Poor (निर्धन)

5. Afraid (डरना): Brave (साहसी), Courageous (वीर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Evince."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Conceal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Evince" means to clearly reveal or demonstrate a feeling or quality. (प्रकट करना)

 

• "Conceal" means to keep something from being seen, known, or discovered. It is therefore the correct antonym. (छिपाना)

◦ Example: He tried to conceal his nervousness by keeping his hands steady and speaking in a measured tone.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Demonstrate (प्रदर्शित करना) — to show clearly by evidence or actions; a synonym of evince.

• Option 2: Display (दिखाना) — to show or exhibit openly; a synonym of evince.

• Option 4: Manifest (प्रकट करना) — to display a quality clearly; a synonym of evince.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of evince: Hide, Disguise, Suppress.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Allay (शांत करना): Aggravate (बढ़ाना), Worsen (खराब करना)

2. Altercation (विवाद): Compromise (समझौता), Agreement (सहमति)

3. Amateur (शौकिया): Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Professional (पेशेवर)

4. Amazed (आश्चर्यचकित): Unimpressed (प्रभावित नहीं), Indifferent (उदासीन)

5. Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Certain (निश्चित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Turbulent".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Calm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Turbulent" means characterized by conflict, disorder, or instability. (अशांत)

◦ Example: The country went through a turbulent period of political unrest before finally holding peaceful elections.

 

• "Calm" means not showing or feeling anger, upset, or excitement; peaceful, and is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)

◦ Example: The lake remained calm and still, perfectly reflecting the mountains under the early morning sky.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Unstable (अस्थिर): likely to change or fail; not firmly fixed — a synonym of turbulent, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Stormy (तूफानी): characterized by strong emotions or conflict; violent — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Chaotic (अराजक): in a state of complete confusion and disorder — close in sense to turbulent.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of turbulent: Chaotic, Stormy, Unstable, Volatile, Tempestuous.

• Synonyms of calm: Peaceful, Tranquil, Serene, Placid, Quiet.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ambition (महत्वाकांक्षा): Laziness (आलस्य)

2. Ambivalent (द्वंद्वात्मक/अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Unequivocal (निर्विवाद)

3. Ambrosial (सुगंधित/स्वादिष्ट): Malodorous (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Foul (बदबूदार)

4. Ameliorate (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Deteriorate (खराब करना)

5. Amplify (बढ़ाना): Reduce (घटाना), Decrease (कम करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Purportedly."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Impossibly.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Purportedly" means as claimed or alleged, though not proven. (कथित रूप से)

 

• "Impossibly" means in a manner that is not possible or achievable. It is therefore the correct antonym. (असंभव रूप से)

◦ Example: The gymnast bent her body impossibly backward, astonishing everyone who watched the flawless performance.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Allegedly (कथित तौर पर) — according to what is said, without proof; a synonym of purportedly.

• Option 3: Ostensibly (दिखावे के तौर पर) — as appears or is stated, perhaps falsely; a synonym of purportedly.

• Option 4: Reportedly (बताया जाता है) — as stated or reported, not necessarily true; a synonym of purportedly.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of purportedly: Actually, Genuinely, Truly, Verifiably.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Amusing (मनोरंजक): Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (नीरस)

2. Angst (चिंता/गुस्सा): Calmness (शांति), Peace (सुकून)

3. Anile (बुढ़ापे जैसा): Young (युवा), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

4. Animosity (दुश्मनी): Benevolence (भलाई), Love (प्रेम)

5. Annoyance (चिड़): Serenity (शांति), Calmness (शांत अवस्था)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Intense".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Moderate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Intense" means existing in an extreme degree; very strong or forceful. (तीव्र)

◦ Example: The soldiers endured intense heat and exhaustion while marching through the desert for several days.

 

• "Moderate" means average in amount, intensity, or degree; not extreme, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मध्यम)

◦ Example: The doctor recommended moderate exercise rather than strenuous workouts for patients recovering from surgery.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Severe (गंभीर): very great or serious in degree — a synonym of intense, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Extreme (अत्यधिक): very great in degree — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Fierce (उग्र): showing strong or aggressive intensity — close in sense to intense.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of intense: Extreme, Severe, Fierce, Strong, Acute.

• Synonyms of moderate: Mild, Average, Modest, Reasonable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Antique (प्राचीन): Modern (आधुनिक), New (नया)

2. Anxiety (चिंता): Relief (राहत)

3. Anxious (चिंतित): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक)

4. Apathy (उदासीनता): Enthusiasm (उत्साह), Interest (रुचि)

5. Apparition (भूत-प्रेत): Realness (वास्तविकता), Reality (हकीकत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Venom."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Benevolent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Venom" means a poisonous substance secreted by an animal, or intense malice. (जहर)

 

• "Benevolent" means well meaning and kindly; showing goodwill. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दयालुता)

◦ Example: The benevolent king ordered that food be distributed freely to every family during the famine.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Poison (जहर) — a substance that causes illness or death when ingested; a synonym of venom.

• Option 2: Malice (द्वेष) — the intention to harm someone; ill will; a synonym of venom.

• Option 3: Toxin (विषाक्त पदार्थ) — a poisonous substance produced by a living organism; a synonym of venom.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of venom: Antidote, Kindness, Goodwill.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Appreciate (सराहना करना): Depreciate (मूल्य घटाना), Criticize (आलोचना करना)

2. Approach (पास आना): Retreat (पीछे हटना), Withdraw (वापस जाना)

3. Appropriate (उचित): Improper (अनुचित)

4. Approve (स्वीकार करना): Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Disapprove (असहमति)

5. Arcane (रहस्यमय): Public (सार्वजनिक), Known (ज्ञात)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Accentuate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Obscure.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Accentuate" means to make something more noticeable or prominent. (ज़ोर देना / उभारना)

◦ Example: The tailored jacket was designed to accentuate her shoulders and create a confident silhouette.

 

• "Obscure" means to make something less clear or harder to notice, and is therefore the correct antonym. (छिपाना / अस्पष्ट करना)

◦ Example: Thick fog began to obscure the mountain road, forcing drivers to slow down considerably.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Emphasize (जोर देना): to give special importance to something — a synonym of accentuate, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Underscore (रेखांकित करना): to emphasize the importance of something — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Highlight (उजागर करना): to draw special attention to something — close in sense to accentuate.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of accentuate: Emphasize, Highlight, Underscore, Stress, Intensify.

• Synonyms of obscure: Conceal, Blur, Mask, Hide, Cloud.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Arraign (आरोप लगाना): Justify (सही ठहराना), Defend (बचाव करना)

2. Arrival (आगमन): Departure (प्रस्थान), Exit (निकास)

3. Ascend (ऊपर जाना): Descend (नीचे उतरना), Fall (गिरना)

4. Assert (दावा करना): Deny (इंकार करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना)

5. Astute (तीक्ष्ण): Stupid (मूर्ख)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Gracious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Miserable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Gracious" means kind, courteous, and pleasant, especially toward others. (दयालु)

◦ Example: Our gracious host welcomed every guest personally and made sure everyone felt comfortable at once.

 

• "Miserable" means extremely unhappy or uncomfortable; wretched, and is therefore the correct antonym. (दुखी/कठोर)

◦ Example: He felt utterly miserable after losing his job and being unable to pay the rent.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Courteous (विनम्र): polite, respectful, and considerate in manner — a synonym of gracious, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Polite (शिष्ट): having or showing good manners toward others — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Kind (दयालु): friendly, generous, and considerate toward others — close in sense to gracious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of gracious: Courteous, Kind, Polite, Amiable, Cordial.

• Synonyms of miserable: Wretched, Unhappy, Sorrowful, Distressed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Attack (हमला): Defend (रक्षा करना), Protect (सुरक्षा करना)

2. Attention (ध्यान): Disregard (अनदेखी), Ignore (नज़रअंदाज़)

3. Attenuate (कमजोर करना): Strong (मजबूत), Strengthen (मजबूत करना)

4. Attracts (आकर्षित करता है): Deters (रोकता है)

5. Audacity (दुस्साहस): Cowardice (कायरता), Fear (भय)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Patriot."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Traitor.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Patriot" means a person who vigorously supports and defends their country. (देशभक्त)

 

• "Traitor" means a person who betrays their country, cause, or friend. It is therefore the correct antonym. (देशद्रोही)

◦ Example: History remembers him as a traitor who sold military secrets to a rival nation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Loyalist (वफादार व्यक्ति) — one who remains loyal to an established authority; a synonym of patriot.

• Option 3: Chauvinist (अंधराष्ट्रवादी) — one excessively or blindly patriotic; a synonym of patriot.

• Option 4: Nationalist (राष्ट्रवादी) — a person with strong national pride or loyalty; a synonym of patriot.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of patriot: Enemy, Betrayer, Defector.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Authorize (अनुमति देना): Forbid (मनाही करना), Prohibit (प्रतिबंध लगाना)

2. Autonomy (स्वायत्तता): Dependence (निर्भरता), Subordination (अधीनता)

3. Avariciousness (लालच): Generosity (उदारता)

4. Average (सामान्य): Exceptional (असाधारण), Outstanding (उत्कृष्ट)

5. Axiom (स्पष्ट सत्य): Absurdity (बेतुकी बात), Falsehood (असत्य)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Hot."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Cold.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Hot" means having a high temperature; giving off heat. (गरम)

 

• "Cold" means having a low temperature, especially compared to the human body. It is therefore the correct antonym. (ठंडा)

◦ Example: A cold wind swept across the valley, forcing the hikers to put on their heavy jackets.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Scorching (झुलसाने वाला) — very hot, especially of weather; a synonym of hot.

• Option 2: Sweltering (उमस भरा) — uncomfortably hot; a synonym of hot.

• Option 4: Warm (गर्म) — having a moderately high temperature; a synonym of hot.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of hot: Frigid, Cool, Chilly.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Babble (बकबक करना): Quiet (शांत), Silence (चुप्पी)

2. Barbarity (क्रूरता): Compassion (दयालुता), Humanity (मानवता)

3. Barbarous (असभ्य): Civilized (सभ्य), Cultured (संस्कृत)

4. Barren (बंजर): Fertile (उपजाऊ), Productive (उत्पादक)

5. Bashful (संकोची / शर्मीला): Loquacious (बातूनी), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Axiom."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Absurdity.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Axiom" means a statement or proposition regarded as self-evidently true. (स्पष्ट सत्य)

 

• "Absurdity" means a statement or idea that is wildly unreasonable or illogical. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बेतुकी बात)

◦ Example: Critics dismissed the politician's claim as an absurdity that had no basis in factual evidence whatsoever.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Truism (सर्वमान्य सत्य) — a statement that is obviously true and says nothing new; a synonym of axiom.

• Option 2: Principle (सिद्धांत) — a fundamental truth that serves as a basis for reasoning; a synonym of axiom.

• Option 3: Maxim (सूक्ति) — a short statement expressing a general truth or rule; a synonym of axiom.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of axiom: Falsehood, Nonsense, Irrationality.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Benevolent (दयालु): Malevolent (दुष्ट), Cruel (क्रूर)

2. Blistering (बहुत गर्म): Chilly (ठंडा), Cool (शीतल)

3. Bloom (खिलना): Wither (मुरझाना), Fade (मंद पड़ना)

4. Boastful (घमंडी): Modest (नम्र), Humble (विनम्र)

5. Bold (साहसी): Timid (डरपोक), Cowardly (कायर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Impervious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Permeable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Impervious" means not allowing fluid to pass through; unable to be affected by something. (अभेद्य)

◦ Example: The waterproof jacket is impervious to rain, keeping hikers completely dry during sudden downpours.

 

• "Permeable" means allowing liquids or gases to pass through, and is therefore the correct antonym. (भेद्य)

◦ Example: Sandy soil is highly permeable, letting rainwater seep quickly down toward the groundwater below.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Impenetrable (अभेद्य): impossible to pass through or enter — a synonym of impervious, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Impermeable (अपारगम्य): not allowing fluid to pass through — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Unaffected (अप्रभावित): not influenced or changed by something — close in sense to impervious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of impervious: impenetrable, impermeable, unaffected, resistant, invulnerable.

• Synonyms of permeable: porous, penetrable, pervious, absorbent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Bombastic (आडंबरपूर्ण): Simple (सरल)

2. Brittle (भंगुर): Resilient (लचीला), Strong (मजबूत)

3. Bulging (फूला हुआ): Contracting (सिकुड़ता हुआ), Shrinking (सिकुड़ता हुआ)

4. Bulk (बड़ा भाग): Handful (थोड़ा)

5. Bumpy (ऊबड़-खाबड़): Steady (स्थिर), Smooth (चिकना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Blistering".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Chilly.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Blistering" means extremely and unpleasantly hot; harshly intense. (बहुत गर्म)

◦ Example: The runners struggled to complete the marathon under the blistering afternoon sun in the desert city.

 

• "Chilly" means noticeably cold; unpleasantly cool, and is therefore the correct antonym. (ठंडा)

◦ Example: A chilly wind swept across the valley as the temperature dropped sharply after sunset.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sweltering (उमस भरा): uncomfortably hot and humid — a synonym of blistering, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Searing (जलाने वाला): extremely hot and burning — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Scorching (झुलसाने वाला): very hot, especially unpleasantly so — close in sense to blistering.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of blistering: scorching, sweltering, searing, sizzling, torrid.

• Synonyms of chilly: cold, cool, frosty, icy, nippy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Cacophony (कर्कश ध्वनि): Symphony (मधुर संगीत), Euphony (मधुर ध्वनि)

2. Cacophony (शोर): Harmony (सामंजस्य), Melody (मधुरता)

3. Cajole (फुसलाना / चापलूसी करना): Bully (धमकाना), Coerce (बलपूर्वक बाध्य करना)

4. Callous (निर्दयी): Sympathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Kind (दयालु)

5. Calm (शांत): Agitate (उत्तेजित), Disturb (परेशान करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Clear."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Nebulous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Clear" means easy to perceive or understand; free from confusion. (साफ/स्पष्ट)

 

• "Nebulous" means unclear, vague, or lacking definite form or shape. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्पष्ट)

◦ Example: The company's nebulous policy on remote work left employees uncertain about the actual rules.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Transparent (पारदर्शी) — easy to perceive or detect; a synonym of clear.

• Option 2: Lucid (स्पष्ट) — expressed clearly and easily understood; a synonym of clear.

• Option 4: Distinct (अलग) — clearly recognizable or noticeable; a synonym of clear.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of clear: Opaque, Murky, Obscure.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Camouflage (छिपाना): Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना)

2. Candid (स्पष्टवादी / निष्कपट): Guarded (संकोची / सतर्क), Deceitful (कपटपूर्ण)

3. Capricious (चंचल): Stable (स्थिर), Consistent (नियमित)

4. Captivity (कैद): Liberty (स्वतंत्रता), Freedom (आजादी)

5. Care (परवाह): Disregard (उपेक्षा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Attenuate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Strong.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Attenuate" means reduce the force, effect, or value of something; weaken. (कमजोर करना)

 

• "Strong" means having great physical power or force. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मजबूत)

◦ Example: Years of rigorous training made the athlete remarkably strong, capable of lifting nearly twice his own body weight.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Dilute (पतला करना) — reduce the strength or concentration of something; a synonym of attenuate.

• Option 3: Weaken (कमज़ोर करना) — make or become weaker; a synonym of attenuate.

• Option 4: Diminish (कम करना) — make or become smaller or less; a synonym of attenuate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of attenuate: Strengthen, Intensify, Reinforce.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Casual (अनौपचारिक): Formal (औपचारिक)

2. Catastrophe (तबाही): Success (सफलता), Blessing (आशीर्वाद)

3. Celebrated (प्रसिद्ध): Inglorious (अप्रसिद्ध), Unknown (अज्ञात)

4. Celerity (तेजी): Slowness (धीमापन), Delay (देरी)

5. Chagrin (खीज/परेशानी): Pleasure (आनंद), Amusement (मनोरंजन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Gumption."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Stupidity.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Gumption" means shrewd or resourceful practical sense; initiative and common sense. (समझदारी)

 

• "Stupidity" means lack of intelligence or good sense; foolishness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मूर्खता)

◦ Example: Investing his entire savings in an unverified scheme was an act of sheer stupidity.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Shrewdness (चतुराई) — sharp practical judgement, especially in difficult situations; a synonym of gumption.

• Option 2: Resourcefulness (साधन-संपन्नता) — the ability to find quick, clever solutions; a synonym of gumption.

• Option 4: Initiative (पहल) — the ability to act independently and decisively; a synonym of gumption.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of gumption: Foolishness, Silliness, Idiocy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Charming (आकर्षक): Repulsive (घिनौना), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक)

2. Chastise (सजा देना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Reward (पुरस्कृत करना)

3. Chicanery (छल): Honesty (ईमानदारी), Integrity (सत्यनिष्ठा)

4. Chided (डांटा): Applauded (सराहा), Praised (प्रशंसा की)

5. Chivalrous (उदार): Cowardly (कायर), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Vivacious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Dull.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Vivacious" means attractively lively, animated, and full of energy. (चंचल)

 

• "Dull" means lacking interest, excitement, or liveliness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (नीरस)

◦ Example: The meeting turned dull after the third hour of discussing minor budget line items.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Animated (सजीव) — full of life and vigor; lively; a synonym of vivacious.

• Option 3: Sprightly (फुर्तीला) — lively, energetic, and full of good spirits; a synonym of vivacious.

• Option 4: Lively (जीवंत) — full of energy and enthusiasm; a synonym of vivacious.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of vivacious: Lifeless, Boring, Monotonous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Chronic (पुराना): Temporary (अस्थायी), Acute (अल्पकालिक)

2. Clandestine (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Public (सार्वजनिक)

3. Clear (साफ/स्पष्ट): Nebulous (अस्पष्ट), Opaque (अपारदर्शी)

4. Cogent (तार्किक): Unconvincing (अविश्वसनीय), Weak (कमज़ोर तर्क)

5. Coherent (व्यवस्थित): Disorganized (अव्यवस्थित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Cumbersome".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Convenient.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Cumbersome" means awkward to carry, use, or handle due to size or complexity. (भारी/परेशानीजनक)

◦ Example: Carrying the cumbersome equipment up three flights of stairs left the technicians exhausted before the exam even began.

 

• "Convenient" means fitting in well with one's needs, easy to use or access, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सुविधाजनक)

◦ Example: The new online portal is far more convenient for students who need to submit their examination forms quickly.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Awkward (अटपटा): difficult to use or handle — a synonym of cumbersome, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Bulky (भारी-भरकम): large and difficult to handle — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Unwieldy (बोझिल): hard to handle due to size — close in sense to cumbersome.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of cumbersome: bulky, unwieldy, awkward, clunky, burdensome.

• Synonyms of convenient: easy, handy, practical, accessible.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Colorful (रंगीन): Monochrome (एकरंगी), Dull (फीका)

2. Commend (प्रशंसा करना): Criticize (आलोचना करना), Condemn (निंदा करना)

3. Commendable (प्रशंसनीय): Blameworthy (निंदनीय), Bad (बुरा)

4. Compassion (सहानुभूति): Meanness (कठोरता), Cruelty (क्रूरता)

5. Compelled (मजबूर): Demur (आपत्ति करना), Free (स्वतंत्र)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Penitence".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Brazenness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Penitence" means deep sorrow or regret for having done wrong. (पश्चाताप)

◦ Example: His genuine penitence after the incident convinced the judge to reduce his sentence.

 

• "Brazenness" means bold and shameless behavior, showing no remorse, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निर्लज्जता)

◦ Example: The thief's brazenness shocked onlookers as he strolled away without any sign of guilt.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Remorse (ग्लानि): deep regret or guilt for wrongdoing — a synonym of penitence, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Contrition (अनुताप): sincere sorrow for having done wrong — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Repentance (तौबा): the act of regretting past wrongdoing — close in sense to penitence.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of penitence: remorse, contrition, repentance, regret, compunction.

• Synonyms of brazenness: shamelessness, audacity, impudence, boldness, effrontery.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Complaint (शिकायत): Praise (प्रशंसा), Appreciation (सराहना)

2. Compulsory (अनिवार्य): Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Optional (वैकल्पिक)

3. Conceal (छिपाना): Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना)

4. Concede (स्वीकार करना): Deny (नकारना)

5. Conceit (अहंकार): Modesty (विनम्रता)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Continued."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Stopped.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Continued" means carried on without interruption; persisted. (जारी)

 

• "Stopped" means brought or came to an end; ceased. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रुका)

◦ Example: Production at the plant stopped abruptly after the workers went on an indefinite strike.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Resumed (फिर से शुरू हुआ) — started again after a pause; a synonym of continued.

• Option 3: Persisted (जारी रहा) — continued firmly despite difficulty; a synonym of continued.

• Option 4: Proceeded (आगे बढ़ा) — continued with an action or process; a synonym of continued.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of continued: Halted, Ceased, Ended.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Concentrate (एकत्र करना): Disperse (बिखेरना), Scatter (छितराना)

2. Concomitant (सहगामी): Independent (स्वतंत्र), Separate (अलग)

3. Condemned (निंदा करना / दोषी ठहराना): Praised (प्रशंसा करना), Approved (स्वीकृत करना)

4. Confronted (सामना किया): Avoided (टाला), Evaded (बच निकला)

5. Conjecture (अनुमान लगाना): Certainty (निश्चितता), Definitely (निश्चित रूप से)
